name: Tigernmas
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: a founder of the gold craft

text: Tigernnas was a king of Tara in Ireland. He followed the cruel god Crom Cruach. He brought the smelting of gold to Ireland, founding one of its oldest crafts.

okr.objective: Set down Tigernmas as the Irish king who founded the gold craft.
key_results: Names him a king of Tara
States he carried gold work to the land
